question_en: List the names of all presidents born in Virginia.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE StateBorn = 'Virginia';

question_en: Show the name and birth year of presidents born after 1850, newest first.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President WHERE YearBorn > 1850 ORDER BY YearBorn DESC;

question_en: List the distinct states in which presidents were born.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT StateBorn FROM President;

question_en: Show the five earliest-born presidents with their birth years.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearBorn FROM President ORDER BY YearBorn ASC LIMIT 5;

question_en: List presidents whose party is 'Federalist'.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PartyName = 'Federalist';

question_en: List presidents whose name starts with 'J'.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PresidentName LIKE 'J%';

question_en: From the marriage records, list spouse names where the marriage status is 'Widowed'.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT SpouseName FROM PresidentMarriage WHERE MarriageStatus = 'Widowed';

question_en: List presidencies (president name and start year) that began in the 1800s.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearHolding FROM PresidentHolding WHERE YearHolding BETWEEN 1800 AND 1899;

question_en: Show all orders shipped to customers in Tokyo (OrderID, ProductName, CustomerCity).
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, CustomerCity FROM Ecommerce WHERE CustomerCity = 'Tokyo';

question_en: List orders with a final price above 1000, showing OrderID, ProductName, and FinalPrice.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, FinalPrice FROM Ecommerce WHERE FinalPrice > 1000;

question_en: List the distinct product categories.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM Ecommerce;

question_en: Show the 10 most recent orders by order date (OrderID, OrderDate).
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, OrderDate FROM Ecommerce ORDER BY OrderDate DESC LIMIT 10;
notes: efficiency: ORDER BY on date at 1M rows

question_en: List orders paid by 'Credit Card' with quantity of at least 5.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, Quantity FROM Ecommerce WHERE PaymentMethod = 'Credit Card' AND Quantity >= 5;

question_en: List orders that were not returned and have a product rating of at least 4.5.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName, ProductRating FROM Ecommerce WHERE ReturnStatus = 'No Return' AND ProductRating >= 4.5;

question_en: Show orders in the 'Clothing' category placed by female customers.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, ProductName FROM Ecommerce WHERE Category = 'Clothing' AND CustomerGender = 'Female';

question_en: List each president together with his spouse's name.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, m.SpouseName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName;

question_en: Show each president with the years he held office (start and end).
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, h.YearHolding, h.YearEnd FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName;

question_en: List presidents who married after first taking office.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE m.MarriageYear > h.YearHolding;
notes: 3-table; ambiguity note: "first" term — gold uses any term; instructor to confirm reading

question_en: List vice presidents who themselves later became president.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT h.VicePresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN PresidentHolding h2 ON h.VicePresidentName = h2.PresidentName WHERE h2.YearHolding > h.YearHolding;

question_en: For each married president, show the spouse name and the president's party.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT m.PresidentName, m.SpouseName, p.PartyName FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN President p ON m.PresidentName = p.PresidentName;

question_en: List presidents from Virginia who began a term before 1850.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentHolding h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName WHERE p.StateBorn = 'Virginia' AND h.YearHolding < 1850;

question_en: List elections (president, start year, runner-up) where the runner-up was himself a president at some time.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT h.PresidentName, h.YearHolding, h.RunnerUp FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN President p ON h.RunnerUp = p.PresidentName;

question_en: List presidents whose spouse was born before the president himself.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, m.SpouseName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date) < p.YearBorn;
notes: date vs year comparison — deliberate subtlety

question_en: List presidents who have no recorded marriage.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName FROM President p LEFT JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE m.PresidentName IS NULL;

question_en: List presidents who held office in two non-consecutive periods (two records with different start years).
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT h1.PresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h1 JOIN PresidentHolding h2 ON h1.PresidentName = h2.PresidentName AND h1.YearHolding < h2.YearHolding WHERE h1.YearEnd < h2.YearHolding;

question_en: List customers (CustomerID) who have placed orders in at least two different categories.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT e1.CustomerID FROM Ecommerce e1 JOIN Ecommerce e2 ON e1.CustomerID = e2.CustomerID AND e1.Category <> e2.Category;

question_en: Find pairs of orders placed by the same customer on the same date (show CustomerID, both OrderIDs).
gold_sql_draft: SELECT e1.CustomerID, e1.OrderID, e2.OrderID FROM Ecommerce e1 JOIN Ecommerce e2 ON e1.CustomerID = e2.CustomerID AND e1.OrderDate = e2.OrderDate AND e1.OrderID < e2.OrderID;

question_en: List president-and-vice-president pairs who were born in the same state.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT h.PresidentName, h.VicePresidentName FROM PresidentHolding h JOIN President p1 ON h.PresidentName = p1.PresidentName JOIN President p2 ON h.VicePresidentName = p2.PresidentName WHERE p1.StateBorn = p2.StateBorn;

question_en: Show the marriage status of every president who began a term in the twentieth century.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DISTINCT m.PresidentName, m.MarriageStatus FROM PresidentMarriage m JOIN PresidentHolding h ON m.PresidentName = h.PresidentName WHERE h.YearHolding BETWEEN 1900 AND 1999;

question_en: List Democratic-Republican presidents whose marriage record shows status 'Widowed'.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName WHERE p.PartyName = 'Democratic-Republican' AND m.MarriageStatus = 'Widowed';

question_en: Count the number of presidents in each party.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PartyName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY PartyName;

question_en: Which state has produced the most presidents? Show the state and the count.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT StateBorn, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY StateBorn ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1;

question_en: What is the average length in years of a presidential term?
gold_sql_draft: SELECT AVG(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS avg_years FROM PresidentHolding;

question_en: List presidents who have more than one marriage record.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM PresidentMarriage GROUP BY PresidentName HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

question_en: For each president in the holding table, show his earliest start year and latest end year.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, MIN(YearHolding) AS first_start, MAX(YearEnd) AS last_end FROM PresidentHolding GROUP BY PresidentName;

question_en: Compute the total revenue of each product category, highest first.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Category, SUM(Revenue) AS total_revenue FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question_en: What is the average customer satisfaction per membership tier?
gold_sql_draft: SELECT MembershipTier, AVG(CustomerSatisfaction) AS avg_sat FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MembershipTier;

question_en: Show the top 5 customer cities by number of orders.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT CustomerCity, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerCity ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5;

question_en: Show monthly total revenue for 2024 in month order.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate::date) AS month, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question_en: List categories whose average product rating exceeds 4.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Category, AVG(ProductRating) AS avg_rating FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category HAVING AVG(ProductRating) > 4;

question_en: For marketing channels with more than 100 orders, show the channel and its total revenue.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT MarketingChannel, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MarketingChannel HAVING COUNT(*) > 100;
notes: threshold rescales with dataset; instructor confirm

question_en: For each brand, count returned-or-exchanged orders versus 'No Return' orders.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Brand, SUM(CASE WHEN ReturnStatus = 'No Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS kept, SUM(CASE WHEN ReturnStatus <> 'No Return' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Brand;

question_en: Show the maximum order revenue for each payment method.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PaymentMethod, MAX(Revenue) AS max_rev FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY PaymentMethod;

question_en: List parties that have had at least three presidents.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PartyName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM President GROUP BY PartyName HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3;

question_en: Show the average delivery days per region, slowest region first.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Region, AVG(DeliveryDays) AS avg_days FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Region ORDER BY avg_days DESC;

question_en: List presidents whose term length exceeded the average term length.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len FROM PresidentHolding WHERE YearEnd - YearHolding > (SELECT AVG(YearEnd - YearHolding) FROM PresidentHolding);

question_en: For each party, show the earliest-born president.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PartyName, PresidentName, YearBorn FROM (SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PartyName ORDER BY YearBorn) AS rn FROM President p) t WHERE rn = 1;

question_en: List presidents who never appear as a runner-up in any election record.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName FROM President WHERE PresidentName NOT IN (SELECT RunnerUp FROM PresidentHolding WHERE RunnerUp IS NOT NULL AND RunnerUp <> 'None');
notes: NOT IN with NULL guard — deliberate trap

question_en: Rank all presidencies by term length, longest first, showing the rank.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT PresidentName, YearEnd - YearHolding AS term_len, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY YearEnd - YearHolding DESC) AS rk FROM PresidentHolding;

question_en: Show the three presidents with the largest age gap between president and spouse.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT p.PresidentName, p.YearBorn - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date) AS gap FROM President p JOIN PresidentMarriage m ON p.PresidentName = m.PresidentName ORDER BY ABS(p.YearBorn - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.SpouseBirthDay::date)) DESC LIMIT 3;

question_en: For each customer, show only their most recent order (CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate).
gold_sql_draft: SELECT CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate FROM (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce e) t WHERE rn = 1;

question_en: Show cumulative revenue over time ordered by order date.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderDate, SUM(Revenue) OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS cum_rev FROM Ecommerce;

question_en: List orders whose final price is above the average final price of their own category.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT OrderID, Category, FinalPrice FROM Ecommerce e WHERE FinalPrice > (SELECT AVG(FinalPrice) FROM Ecommerce e2 WHERE e2.Category = e.Category);

question_en: Show month-over-month change in total revenue for 2024.
gold_sql_draft: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', OrderDate::date) AS month, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, total, total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change FROM m;

question_en: For each category, show its top 3 products by total revenue.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT Category, ProductName, total FROM (SELECT Category, ProductName, SUM(Revenue) AS total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Category ORDER BY SUM(Revenue) DESC) AS rn FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY Category, ProductName) t WHERE rn <= 3;

question_en: List customers whose total spending is above the 95th percentile of customer totals.
gold_sql_draft: WITH s AS (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT CustomerID, total FROM s WHERE total > (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total) FROM s);

question_en: Show each marketing channel's share of total revenue as a percentage.
gold_sql_draft: SELECT MarketingChannel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(Revenue) / SUM(SUM(Revenue)) OVER (), 2) AS pct FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY MarketingChannel;

question_en: For each customer with at least two orders, show the number of days between their first and second order.
gold_sql_draft: WITH o AS (SELECT CustomerID, OrderDate::date AS d, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY OrderDate) AS rn FROM Ecommerce) SELECT a.CustomerID, (b.d - a.d) AS days_between FROM o a JOIN o b ON a.CustomerID = b.CustomerID AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2;

question_en: Using a CTE, count how many presidents were born in each decade.
gold_sql_draft: WITH d AS (SELECT PresidentName, (YearBorn / 10) * 10 AS decade FROM President) SELECT decade, COUNT(*) AS n FROM d GROUP BY decade ORDER BY decade;

question_en: Show the 7-day moving average of daily total revenue.
gold_sql_draft: WITH daily AS (SELECT OrderDate::date AS d, SUM(Revenue) AS total FROM Ecommerce GROUP BY OrderDate::date) SELECT d, AVG(total) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma7 FROM daily;
